summary:
Implemented two iPhone-visible resume improvements:

- Quick Sheet roadside contact cards now timestamp local edits and resurface from Home Resume Work and Global Search Recent Work, with routes back to the Tow / Shop Arrival Pack.
- Diagnostics Local Resume now has a dynamic `Open Latest` action that opens the freshest saved handoff, first checks, or call draft instead of always pointing to Call Summary.
- Bumped PWA cache to `ridgeline-console-v448` and updated `AGENT_STATE.md`.

Verified with:
`node --check agent-status.js quick-sheet.js shared-ui.js diagnostics.js service-worker.js`
`Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
`git diff --check` passed with only existing LF-to-CRLF warnings.

`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1` timed out again, and the browser plugin control tool was not exposed, so interactive iPhone smoke could not be completed.

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: Home/Search can now recover a filled roadside contact card, and Diagnostics can open the actual latest local diagnostic thread.
Impact Reason: This reduces tap hunting on iPhone during roadside or diagnostic follow-up, especially when returning after a task was started earlier.
Ended Early Because: Further useful work needed interactive browser verification, but the audit wrapper timed out and direct browser control was unavailable.
